issues.problem: The URL redirects to top10.owasp.org and the fetched excerpt is only 'Redirecting...', so it does not show the claims cited from it. I confirmed those claims from my own knowledge of the A10:2021 Prevention section. They are 'Disable HTTP redirections', 'Be aware of the URL consistency to avoid attacks such as DNS rebinding and TOCTOU', and 'Do not mitigate SSRF via the use of a deny list or regular expression'. The cheat sheet excerpt is also cut off before Case 2. Its allowlisting, IP validation, DNS pinning and network-layer points match my own knowledge of the page.
issues.suggestedFix: Optionally point the link at the final URL https://top10.owasp.org/A10_2021-Server-Side_Request_Forgery_(SSRF)/ so that a link checker and readers do not need to follow a redirect.
